scenes.anchor_text:
In the shade of the house, in the sunshine of the riverbank near the boats, in
the shade of the Sal-wood forest, in the shade of the fig tree is where
Siddhartha grew up, the handsome son of the Brahman, the young falcon, together
with his friend Govinda, son of a Brahman.
scenes.scene_description: Siddhartha and Govinda's youth. A serene riverbank scene with boats, lush trees, and a simple house, capturing the idyllic beginnings of their lives.

scenes.anchor_text:
The sun tanned his light shoulders
by the banks of the river when bathing, performing the sacred ablutions, the
sacred offerings. In the mango grove, shade poured into his black eyes, when
playing as a boy, when his mother sang, when the sacred offerings were made,when his father, the scholar, taught him, when the wise men talked.
scenes.scene_description: Siddhartha performing sacred ablutions in the river. Early morning scene with soft lighting and mist rising from the water, depicting the ritualistic aspect of his upbringing.

scenes.anchor_text:
For a long
time, Siddhartha had been partaking in the discussions of the wise men,
practising debate with Govinda, practising with Govinda the art of reflection,
the service of meditation. He already knew how to speak the Om silently, the
word of words, to speak it silently into himself while inhaling, to speak it
silently out of himself while exhaling, with all the concentration of his soul,
the forehead surrounded by the glow of the clear-thinking spirit.
scenes.scene_description: Siddhartha meditating with Govinda. They sit beneath a banyan tree, deeply engrossed in meditation. Focus on the tranquil environment that enhances their spiritual practice.
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic digital painting, Two young boys sitting in meditation, Large Banyan tree with intricate root system, diffused light filtering through leaves, serene and quiet atmosphere, atmospheric narrative, muted greens and browns, soft light highlighting faces, medium shot focusing on their posture, Siddhartha: serene expression, Govinda: focused gaze

scenes.anchor_text:
But more than all the others he was loved by Govinda, his friend, the son of a
Brahman. He loved Siddhartha’s eye and sweet voice, he loved his walk and
the perfect decency of his movements, he loved everything Siddhartha did and
said and what he loved most was his spirit, his transcendent, fiery thoughts,
his ardent will, his high calling.
scenes.scene_description: Govinda observing Siddhartha. Govinda watches Siddhartha walking through a lane in town, admiring his friend's aura and presence from a respectful distance.
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic digital painting, A young boy watches his friend walking through a small town lane, Traditional Indian style town with houses lining the lane, Muted colors with highlights on Siddhartha, atmospheric narrative, muted earthy tones, diffused sunlight, medium shot focusing on Govinda's perspective, Govinda: respectful gaze, Siddhartha: confident stride

scenes.anchor_text:
Walking the rosy paths of the fig tree garden, sitting in the bluish
shade of the grove of contemplation, washing his limbs daily in the bath of
repentance, sacrificing in the dim shade of the mango forest, his gestures of
perfect decency, everyone’s love and joy, he still lacked all joy in his
heart.
scenes.scene_description: Siddhartha alone in the mango forest. Focus on the environment with him as part of it.
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic digital painting, A lone young man standing in the mango forest, Dense mango forest with filtered sunlight, sense of isolation, atmospheric narrative, muted greens and yellows, diffused light casting long shadows, wide shot emphasizing isolation, Siddhartha: thoughtful expression

scenes.anchor_text:
Siddhartha had started to nurse discontent in himself, he had started to feel
that the love of his father and the love of his mother, and also the love of
his friend, Govinda, would not bring him joy for ever and ever, would not nurse
him, feed him, satisfy him.
scenes.scene_description: Siddhartha overlooking the river. A contemplative scene showing Siddhartha by the river, the vastness of nature mirroring his internal restlessness and dissatisfaction.
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic digital painting, A young man standing on the riverbank looking out at the river, Wide river scene with forest in the background, sense of vastness, atmospheric narrative, muted blues and greens, diffused light, wide shot emphasizing his smallness compared to nature, Siddhartha: contemplative stance

scenes.anchor_text:
They went to the Banyan tree, they sat down, Siddhartha right here, Govinda
twenty paces away. While putting himself down, ready to speak the Om,
Siddhartha repeated murmuring the verse:
Om is the bow, the arrow is soul, The Brahman is the arrow’s target, That
one should incessantly hit.
scenes.scene_description: Siddhartha and Govinda meditating beneath a Banyan tree. Siddhartha sits, preparing for deep meditation, the Banyan tree's roots spread around them, visualizing the 'Om' as bow and arrow.

scenes.anchor_text:
Once, Samanas had travelled through Siddhartha’s town, ascetics on a
pilgrimage, three skinny, withered men, neither old nor young, with dusty and
bloody shoulders, almost naked, scorched by the sun, surrounded by loneliness,
strangers and enemies to the world, strangers and lank jackals in the realm of
humans.
scenes.scene_description: The Samanas passing through town. Focus on their disheveled appearance and the stark contrast between them and the townsfolk.

scenes.anchor_text:
After an hour, since no sleep had come over his eyes, the Brahman stood up,
paced to and fro, and left the house. Through the small window of the chamber
he looked back inside, and there he saw Siddhartha standing, his arms folded,
not moving from his spot. Pale shimmered his bright robe. With anxiety in his
heart, the father returned to his bed.
scenes.scene_description: The father looking in on Siddhartha. The father peers through a small window at Siddhartha, who stands motionless in the chamber, the moonlight casting a pale glow.
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic digital painting, A father peering through a small window at his son, Simple chamber with a mat on the floor, moonlight shining through the window, atmospheric narrative, muted blues and grays, soft moonlight, medium shot focusing on the father's perspective, Siddhartha: standing motionless, Brahman: anxious gaze

scenes.anchor_text:
As he slowly left on stiff legs in the first light of day the still quiet town,
a shadow rose near the last hut, who had crouched there, and joined the
pilgrim—Govinda.
“You have come,” said Siddhartha and smiled.
“I have come,” said Govinda.
scenes.scene_description: Siddhartha leaving the town with Govinda. They depart into the early morning light, the town behind them, starting their journey towards the Samanas.
